title: Petition of Massachusetts Municipal Wholesale Electric Company ("MMWEC") under Chapter 775 of the Acts of 1975 requesting approval by the Department of Public Utilities of an increase from $2,000,000 in the level of previously authorized borrowing from time to time by the issuance of bonds, notes, and other evidences of indebtedness, to obtain lines of credit to provide funds for the cost of power purchases for various cities and towns under arrangements with the New England Power Exchange, the purchase of power from other utilities, the purchase of power by MMWEC for resale to various cities and towns, for transmission support costs, and other related costs.
